title: Prescription Insurance on File: Waiting Share on a Corrected Claim
content:
A corrected claim made under **Prescription Insurance on File** after the patient has waited on the correction earns a waiting share. The wait is measured from the most recent reversal on the coverage made for a billing correction to the day the corrected claim is made, in calendar days.

## Rule

- More than **7** days before the day the corrected claim is made: the charge is multiplied by **0.5**.
- **3** to 7 days before: the charge is multiplied by **0.75**.
- Otherwise the charge is multiplied by 1, that is, no waiting share.

The share multiplies the unrounded charge; the patient pay is rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Boundary table

| Days from the reversal to the corrected claim | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | 1 |
| 3 | 0.75 |
| 7 | 0.75 |
| 8 | 0.5 |
| 20 | 0.5 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- Reversal for a billing correction on 1 June, corrected claim made on 5 June: 4 days — the charge is multiplied by 0.75.
- Reversal on 1 June, corrected claim on 9 June: 8 days — multiplied by 0.5.
- Reversal on 1 June, corrected claim on 2 June: 1 day — no waiting share.
